marker: # ref_size is the product length measured in the CO92 assembly GCA_000009065.1 (chromosome AL590842.1)
# by in silico PCR with these primers, outer primer edge to outer primer edge. All 42 primer pairs give
# exactly one product there. The publication gives no product sizes, so there is nothing to compare it
# with; it anchors the allele formula on CO92 together with the published copy numbers.
# unit_length and ref_repeats are read from the publication's CO92 array column, in which '1 by 11'
# means a 1 bp unit at 11 copies. Repeat detection in the CO92 amplicons confirms 40 of 42
# published unit lengths independently. The exceptions are:
# M33 holds 9 copies of a 9 bp unit rather than the published 22, and its strongest signal is a higher
# order 18 bp period; M36 is published as a single copy, so there is no array in the reference at all.
# The number of whole units in the amplicon differs from the published copy number for several markers,
# in both directions, so the column was not misread: the published values are most likely counted on
# the draft sequence available in 2001 or by different criteria. They are kept, because they define the
# published allele numbering and there is no better source, and ref_size is measured here so that the
# two are consistent for CO92. Marker, published copies and units found:
# patterns are left N/A because the publication gives no consensus repeat sequences. The tandem array
# cross-check is therefore skipped for every marker and alleles rest on amplicon length alone.
# ref_repeats is fractional for M23, M58 and M65, as published; the alleles of those markers lie on a
# half-integer grid and mlvatyper numbers them on that grid rather than treating n.5 as intermediate.
